title: Set up your firm's BoQs
intro: Three things your BoQs need, done once: how you measure, your item numbers and texts, and what the names in your models mean. Everything here can be changed later in the Library.
notAllowed: Owners, admins and library editors set up the firm. Until they do, BoQs use the neutral system rules.
doneAlready: Your firm's setup is finished. Running it again starts new drafts of your presets; published versions stay as they are.
noModel: Pick a model at the start to see the BoQ lines change as you answer.

start.title: Set up your firm's BoQs
start.intro: About fifteen minutes. Every question comes with a suggested answer; "Use the suggested answers" finishes a step at once.
start.modelHint: Optional. The preview shows its BoQ lines under your answers.
start.continue: Continues in a new draft of {name}.

measure.checklistIntro: Tick what your BoQs should contain. The suggested answers are ticked already.
measure.required: Give an answer: 0 is never what is meant here.

items.title: Item numbers and texts
items.intro: Import your item list from Excel or CSV (Code list › Import), or skip: lines stay grouped as "All lines" until a classification exists. Then choose which item each kind of line gets (Codes per line).

names.title: Names in your models
names.intro: The names the engine didn't understand: say what each one means. They go into your company dictionary.
names.noModel: Without a model there are no names to explain; the first BoQ will ask about them instead.
names.skip: Skip: ask on the first BoQ

review.title: Review and publish
review.intro: What your setup holds. Publishing makes these the presets new projects start with.
review.rulesSummary: {n, plural, =0 {The suggested answers, unchanged.} one {# answer differs from the rule set it starts from.} other {# answers differ from the rule set they start from.}}
review.itemsSummary: {codes, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}, {rules, plural, =0 {no line has an item yet} one {# rule gives lines their item} other {# rules give lines their item}}.
review.itemsNone: No item list yet: lines stay grouped as "All lines".
review.namesSummary: {n, plural, one {# name taught} other {# names taught}}.
review.namesNone: No names taught yet: the first BoQ will ask.
review.staysDraft: Nothing to publish: it stays a draft.
review.notInModels: A BoQ contains only what the models contain. Work that isn't modelled as objects (site setup, scaffolding, finishes not drawn) is added as manual lines in the sheet.
review.applyTo: Use them as the defaults of {project}
review.blocked: Fix the problems above before publishing.

notFinished: Your firm's setup isn't finished yet. BoQs use the neutral system rules until it is.
hint: These numbers use the neutral "As modelled" rules. Set up your firm's rules →
